meta.title: Bedrock core journeys
meta.description: Ordered multi-stage walks through the chamber atlas for ground-shaking life. Chambers are stations; journeys are paths. Shared spine: blow → near → spiral → fork → long_middle → remain. People loop spiral↔fork↔long_middle; the path is to keep walking, not complete a checklist.

families.body: Blow to the body — loss, wound, abandonment
families.will: Blow to the will — bondage, loops, grip, mind war
families.conscience: Blow to the conscience — fall, return, regret
families.world: Blow to the world — persecution, warfare, forced wait

journeys.title: Death of a loved one
journeys.summary: Mourning is not unbelief. Hope does not erase tears. Empty hands. Remain today.

stages.label: Loss
stages.note: Name the death. Mourning is not unbelief.

stages.label: Presence
stages.note: Presence before advice.

stages.label: Promises
stages.note: Faithful when the chair is empty.

stages.label: Lament
stages.note: You do not have to act fine.

stages.label: Hope
stages.note: Present pain real; future glory more real. Hold both.

stages.label: Wait
stages.note: Time moves; they do not.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Peace is given, not earned by forcing the timeline.

journeys.title: Marriage Shaken
journeys.summary: Marriage is shaken — left, leaving, betrayal, or fracture. Name it under God. You are still His. Do not let their choices rule your peace. Do your part. Leave the rest to God.
journeys.shareSummary: Marriage is shaken. Lifelong one-flesh covenant — not of feelings. Name it under God.

stages.label: Shaken
stages.note: This is marriage before God. Feelings collapsed; His design did not. Name that the covenant is under fire.

stages.label: Wound
stages.note: Name the harm done to you. Not all of it is your fault. Do not hide in hate.

stages.label: You are His
stages.note: You are still His. Do not let their choices rule your peace.

stages.label: Wave
stages.note: When memory or pain surges: notice, own your state, return to what is in front of you.

stages.label: Replay
stages.note: Obsession is not revelation. Stop feeding the loop.

stages.label: Fear
stages.note: Name the fear — loss, alone, future. Then trust God.

stages.label: Grip
stages.note: Stop securing their heart, the timeline, the outcome. Do your part. Leave the rest.

stages.label: Vengeance
stages.note: Flesh wants payback. Leave the scales to God.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Bless. Do not multiply darkness.

stages.label: Covenant
stages.note: Do not invent a new story. Stay true to what God still calls true.

stages.label: Stand
stages.note: Walking away looks easier. Ease is not the deciding factor. The covenant is.

stages.label: The Line
stages.note: How you stand every day: your state is your own · presence without control · love keeps no record.

stages.label: Forgive
stages.note: Not saying it did not hurt. Release the debt. Grief may stay.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: You cannot force the outcome — them, timeline, or certainty.

stages.label: Standard
stages.note: Refuse the flesh. Walk in the Spirit. Do your part.

stages.label: Remain
stages.note: Stand under trial.

journeys.title: Deep wound
journeys.summary: You were harmed. God sees. Do not repay evil; forgive over time; keep wise boundaries.

stages.label: Wound
stages.note: Name the harm. Not all of it is your fault.

stages.label: For you
stages.note: Cast the care on Him. Do not dress it up.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Evil repaid multiplies darkness.

stages.label: Vengeance
stages.note: Be still. Leave wrath to God.

stages.label: Forgive
stages.note: Release the debt. Grief may stay.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Receive His guard over heart and mind.

journeys.title: Abandonment fear
journeys.summary: Perfect love casts out fear. You cry Abba — not slave to terror. Trust when the face is gone.

stages.label: Fear
stages.note: Perfect love casts out fear.

stages.label: Do not fear
stages.note: Command and comfort.

stages.label: For you
stages.note: Stop rehearsing every face against you.

stages.label: Promises
stages.note: What does not depend on them.

stages.label: Capture
stages.note: Fear thoughts are not prophecy.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Let the peace of Christ rule this hour.

journeys.title: Addiction
journeys.summary: If it masters you, it is not free. Name the master; walk by the Spirit one hour; get real help.

stages.label: Master
stages.note: Lawful is not free if it masters you.

stages.label: Craving
stages.note: Craving is not command.

stages.label: Renew
stages.note: Old pattern returns. Word + prayer. One thought under Christ.

stages.label: Spirit
stages.note: Put the flesh to death one hour at a time.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Spirit fruit for you.

stages.label: Confess
stages.note: Trying alone is not enough. Get real help.

stages.label: Grace
stages.note: Weakness is where His power is perfected.

stages.label: Remain
stages.note: One next sober step; real help when needed.

journeys.title: Obsession
journeys.summary: The stuck replaying mind is not the Holy Spirit. Capture the thought. Replace it with truth. Take the next right step.

stages.label: Loop
stages.note: Obsession is not revelation.

stages.label: Capture
stages.note: Capture to obey Christ.

stages.label: Word
stages.note: Open Scripture; fight fog with light.

stages.label: Prayer
stages.note: Do not feed the loop.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Next duty, not more analysis.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Mind stayed on Him.

journeys.title: Control
journeys.summary: Stop securing the outcome. Rule yourself, not them. Do not let their choices rule your peace. Do your part. Trust God with the rest.

stages.label: Grip
stages.note: If you must force the outcome, it has become a god. Stop securing it.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Release the outcome you cannot rule.

stages.label: Patience
stages.note: You do not control the weather.

stages.label: Wait
stages.note: Do the one duty you own today.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Rule yourself, not them.

stages.label: Presence
stages.note: Be present. Don’t force present or future.

stages.label: Spirit
stages.note: Flesh wants the last word over another life.

stages.label: Standard
stages.note: Refuse the flesh. Do your part. Success is Spirit, not their response.

journeys.title: Jealousy
journeys.summary: Jealousy is not love. Capture the thought. Choose selfless love. Trust God with what you cannot hold.

stages.label: Jealousy
stages.note: Not love.

stages.label: Capture
stages.note: Rival thoughts are not truth.

stages.label: Vengeance
stages.note: Do not turn rivalry into payback.

stages.label: Love
stages.note: Love does not seek its own way.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Release what you cannot hold.

journeys.title: I fell
journeys.summary: Name the fall. Confess. Grace is enough. Rise. The righteous man falls and gets up again.

stages.label: Fall
stages.note: I sinned. I am not finished.

stages.label: Confess
stages.note: Concealment will not prosper.

stages.label: Grace
stages.note: Receive mercy; renounce the flesh habit.

stages.label: Cross
stages.note: Self-hate is not holiness.

stages.label: Spirit
stages.note: Rise and walk again.

stages.label: Grief
stages.note: Worldly grief only kills. Rise.

stages.label: Hope
stages.note: Your fall does not end the story.

journeys.title: Sexual sin
journeys.summary: Confess, forsake, be cleansed. Do not call darkness a new identity. Deny yourself; walk by the Spirit.

stages.label: Lust
stages.note: Lust of the eyes is already adultery of the heart. Flee. Do not rename darkness.

stages.label: Confess
stages.note: Forsake; receive cleansing.

stages.label: Idolatry
stages.note: Sex, image, or person as god — tear the idol down.

stages.label: Deny
stages.note: Cross daily; refuse self as god of this hour.

stages.label: Self-control
stages.note: Spirit fruit.

stages.label: Spirit
stages.note: One hour free.

stages.label: Faithfulness
stages.note: When marriage is in view — faithfulness, not fantasy.

stages.label: Rise
stages.note: Identity is not the sin.

journeys.title: Stuck regret
journeys.summary: Godly grief leads to life. Worldly grief only kills. Own what is yours. Self-hate is not holiness. Rise.

stages.label: Regret
stages.note: Godly grief leads to life. Worldly grief only kills.

stages.label: Confess
stages.note: Own what is yours.

stages.label: Grace
stages.note: No condemnation in Christ. Stop performing shame.

stages.label: Cross
stages.note: Christ died for sins; rise.

stages.label: Replay
stages.note: Regret loop is not holiness.

stages.label: Rise
stages.note: Next obedience.

journeys.title: Persecution
journeys.summary: Blessed when persecuted for righteousness. Armor on; do not repay; remain faithful; hope of glory.
plainSpeech: they're against me for my faith

stages.label: Persecution
stages.note: For His name — not every conflict is this.

stages.label: Armor
stages.note: Stand.

stages.label: Warfare
stages.note: Not against flesh and blood. Stand under Christ.

stages.label: Do not repay
stages.note: Bless when insulted.

stages.label: Faithful
stages.note: Found doing when He comes.

stages.label: Hope
stages.note: Crowns for those who remain.

journeys.title: Spiritual warfare
journeys.summary: Christ has already won. Fix your eyes on Jesus. Stand with God. Walk by the Spirit.

stages.label: War
stages.note: Not against flesh and blood.

stages.label: Adversary
stages.note: Christ has won. Eyes on Jesus.

stages.label: Armor
stages.note: Stand equipped.

stages.label: Word
stages.note: Open Scripture. The lie says you cannot understand — God says you can.

stages.label: Prayer
stages.note: Pray. Keep your eyes on the Lord.

stages.label: Capture
stages.note: Accusation and despair are not the Spirit.

stages.label: Stand
stages.note: Eyes on Christ.

journeys.title: Forced waiting
journeys.summary: You cannot force the timeline. Wait on the Lord; trust; one duty today; provision for this day.

stages.label: Wait
stages.note: You cannot force the timeline. Force is flesh.

stages.label: Patience
stages.note: Urgency is not wisdom. Spirit fruit under delay.

stages.label: Trust
stages.note: Lean not on panic as wisdom.

stages.label: God first
stages.note: Seek first the kingdom in the next five minutes.

stages.label: Bread
stages.note: This day, not the whole future.

stages.label: Prayer
stages.note: Cast cares on Him. Do not dress them up.

stages.label: Remain
stages.note: Keep remaining today.

journeys.title: Battlefield of the mind
journeys.summary: The war is often inside. Capture the thought. Refuse the accuser. Renew the mind. Stand in the armor of God.

stages.label: War
stages.note: The blow is a thought. Capture it.

stages.label: Standard
stages.note: Kill the flesh. Walk in the Spirit. Use the full holds when needed.

stages.label: Loop
stages.note: Replay and building a case are not the Holy Spirit. Capture. Replace.

stages.label: Darts
stages.note: Fiery darts may come. Raise the shield of faith. Eyes on Jesus.

stages.label: Condemnation
stages.note: Godly grief leads to life. Worldly grief only kills. Self-hate is not holiness.

stages.label: Wounds
stages.note: Harsh words stick. God is near the crushed. Do not hide in hate.

stages.label: Renew
stages.note: One thought at a time. Word over the spiral.

stages.label: Fear
stages.note: Perfect love casts out fear. Sound mind.

stages.label: Peace
stages.note: Peace is given — not earned by solving every open question.

stages.label: Stand
stages.note: Shield of faith. Stand.
